label: For "Patient Safety Incident Prioritization": Triage patient-safety incident reports by potential severity, urgency, recurrence and required review pathway, so safety professionals open the highest-risk reports first and mandatory escalations are never delayed. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on reporter-assigned severity.
